_comment: Manual license corrections where GitHub's detector is wrong. Each needs a reason a reader can check. reuse_ok: true only when the corrected license is permissive AND verified by reading the repository's license files.

GNOME/aisleriot.why: the code is GPL-3.0-or-later; GitHub's detector picked one of several COPYING files (card art)

xrLil-Batya/xray-oxygen.why: ships GSC Game World's X-Ray engine source, licensed only for non-commercial use

urxp/dRally.why: decompiler output of a commercial game

zaps166/NFSIISE.why: built on a disassembly of a commercial game

mboyd-1240/ea-fc-27-pc-setup-gameplay-hu.why: download lure named after a commercial game

riverflow668/Lostminer-der-einfache-eins.why: README-only page whose download goes through a URL shortener

helloyanis/Groove2offline.why: README distributes a modified commercial APK from file hosts

deokseon/D-BMS.note: README links an off-site executable; build from source
